ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level contrast; predominantly low-intensity dark pixels (estimated >90% coverage) with sparse, localized high-intensity white pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigmentation across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white mottling clusters are localized in the center-right mid-region and along the trailing edge of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex; approximate 65-degree internal angle relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire visible trailing edge; irregularities increase in amplitude toward the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning to sharp posterior-facing tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple discrete circular white pixel clusters (2-5 pixel diameter) scattered across the mid-ventral surface of the right lobe and central peduncle region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical and diagonal linear disruptions of lighter grey pixels visible on the upper-mid section of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged segments and small notches present at the outer distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
